+"""Directed soft reassignment of source code probabilities by target context."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Return the masked directed KL term specified by the frozen proposal.
+
+    ``source`` and ``target`` have distinct roles: target distances tilt the
+    source logits before forming q, while p is determined by source alone.
+    """
+    tau = parameters.get("tau", 0.2)
+    alpha = parameters.get("alpha", 0.5)
+    eps = parameters.get("eps", 1e-8)
+    weight = parameters.get("weight", 0.001)
+
+    source_logits = -((source[:, None, :] - codebook[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(-1) / tau
+    target_logits = -((target[:, None, :] - codebook[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(-1) / tau
+    p = F.softmax(source_logits, dim=-1)
+    q = F.softmax(source_logits + alpha * target_logits, dim=-1)
+    per_pair = (q * (torch.log(q) - torch.log(p + eps))).sum(dim=-1)
+    # Apply the mask before reduction; do not renormalize by valid count.
+    return weight * (per_pair * mask.to(dtype=per_pair.dtype)).mean()
